routes.label: electronic passport, collected in person at an Immigration office

note: The electronic passport is for citizens aged 10 to 65, collected in person at an Immigration office; the non-electronic passport (MVR 600, 32 pages) is for children below 10, applicants 65 and over, applicants residing abroad and people with an illness, disability or medical condition. The page gives 'aged 10 to 65' and '65 years and above', so at 65 both are offered; the game gives a 65-year-old the electronic passport, and the non-electronic one from 66. Processing time is a lead.

sources.title: Maldives Immigration (immigration.gov.mv), Passport
sources.said: Electronic Passport (Ordinary) Issued for general travel purposes. For citizens aged 10 to 65 years Applicants aged 10–18 must attend with one parent. ... Collection Must be collected in person at an Immigration office. 32 / 48 Pages 5 years Validity Fee (MVR): 1,000 (32 pages) / 1,500 (48 pages) Non-e Non-electronic Passport Specific categories only Issued to: Children below 10 years Applicants aged 65 years and above Applicants residing abroad Individuals with permanent illness, disability, or temporary medical condition Collection Collection may be authorized to a third party with appropriate documentation. 32 Pages 5 years Validity Fee (MVR): 600
